subject: Cross-region seat commit, EU data carve & APAC onramp plan
messages:
From: Emma Jiang <emma.jiang@medivista.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 May 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal planning — EU data carve + APAC pilot ask

Hi Naomi,

Hope you had a good week. We're preparing our contract renewal (term ends 2028-07-15) and want to discuss a few changes before we sign:

- EU data carve: we need EU-hosted inference for all EU traffic (data residency + access controls).
- APAC onramp: pilot warm-standby in APAC for Q4 with an initial capacity target of ~200k tokens/day, ramp to 500k within 3 months.
- Seat/commit uplift: we expect to increase concurrent seat commits by ~30% for the first 12 months.

Procurement timeline: we need a commercial proposal + SOW by 2028-05-30 to get PO issued in early June. I'm attaching our internal procurement checklist and a one-page requirements doc.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can support EU-only routing for EU tenants during the renewal and an APAC warm-standby architecture (non-replicated primary for now) with cross-region failover? Also need a draft amendment showing term, pricing impact, and SLAs so we can brief legal.

Thanks,
Emma

--
Emma Jiang
Head of Platform Ops, Medivista
emma.jiang@medivista.com

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 23 May 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal planning — EU data carve + APAC pilot ask

Hi Emma,

Thanks for the clear note and the checklist — this is doable. High-level proposal so we can align with procurement/legal:

1) Term & commercial
- 24-month extension (auto-renew opt-out at month 20).
- Commit uplift: +30% concurrent seats for 12 months; pricing adjusted on committed throughput (tokens/day tiers).
- APAC pilot priced as a staged add-on: pilot month-to-month for first 90 days, then convert to reserved capacity if ramp target is hit.

2) Regions & routing
- EU data carve: we will route EU-origin requests to EU-only dedicated tenancy and enable a data-locality policy (no mirror to non-EU locations).
- APAC: warm-standby (cold mirror with KV cache prefetch) — failover path tested quarterly.

3) SLAs and evidence
- SLA addendum with dedicated latency and availability targets for EU tenancy; we will include SOC2 + Azure/AWS region attestations in the evidence pack.

I'll attach a draft amendment (SOW + pricing spreadsheet) for your review. Ben and Marissa — can you validate ops runbook and rough MRC/OPEX delta for the proposed warm-standby? Procurement needs the draft on or before 2028-05-30.

Next step: I'll schedule a 30-min sync for Monday 2028-05-27 10:00 AM BST (I've tentatively booked). If that doesn't work, propose alternate times.

Best,
Naomi

Naomi / Marissa — quick ops notes and asks from infra planning:

- For EU-only routing we recommend a small dedicated pool (2 x A100 equiv) with prefix / KV caching enabled; that will keep p95 latency within the committed SLA for the EU tenant.
- APAC warm-standby plan: we can seed KV cache during low-traffic windows and maintain a 6-hour prefetch window. Initial sizing estimates attached (capacity-map.png).
- Cost: pilot OPEX (month-to-month) ~ $22k/month for the 200k tokens/day baseline; if they convert to reserved we can offer a 22% discount on reserved MRC.

We should include an emergency surge credit (one-time pool of token credits) in the amendment to cover an initial spike during cutover.

I'll update the SOW with the ops runway and add the technical acceptance criteria (TAC).

Ben
